profile.org_note: Five homebuilding segments (West, Mountain, Texas, Southeast, Century Complete) plus Century Living and Financial Services; the Executive Chairman and CEO are jointly the chief operating decision makers. Regional presidents run each segment over city divisions, and Century Complete has its own national president (Dave Hodgman) over five sub-regions. Land is sourced by division VPs of land, packaged for a corporate Asset Management Committee, and overseen by James Francescon (EVP Corporate Operations, President from 2027-01-01); a Senior Vice President of Land Acquisition exists per job postings but is not named.
profile.summary: Top-10 public builder focused on affordable and entry-level homes: 10,387 new homes delivered and $4.1 billion of revenue in 2025, in 16 states and 45-plus markets under the Century Communities and Century Complete (online, finished-lot) brands. It held 60,916 lots at year-end 2025, 57.1% owned and 42.9% optioned, down from 80,632 a year earlier after walking away from contracts, and spent about $1.2 billion on land and development in 2025. Growth is by buying local builders for their lot pipelines: HistoryMaker Homes (Dallas-Fort Worth, October 2026, with an ongoing land-development relationship with its sister company Jabez Development) followed Anglia Homes and Landmark Homes of Tennessee in 2024.
